_comment: Copy-paste detection config for jscpd (run by Mega-Linter Lint-Security). MegaLinter's FILTER_REGEX_EXCLUDE does NOT apply to jscpd because jscpd runs in 'project' mode and consumes its own config; per-jscpd ignore globs must live HERE. The vendor/regex-vis/ tree is third-party MIT-licensed code (see THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md) and its internal duplication is upstream's problem, not this plugin's; same for _dev folders (per-project ephemera) and node_modules / .venv (toolchain).
